_about: Staged transcription of one reference channel. Text is copied verbatim from the cited files under docs/m2-handoff/ (only the bullet marker is removed). Card values were read from the card images. Nothing here is interpreted: identities are resolved in identity-map.json and numbers are parsed by the loader.

lines.text: Increases self agility, chakra, and hp, 92% speed, 70% damage rate, and 70% avoid injury.
Increases all allies' speed by 116%, hp by 30%, and attack by 30%.
Immune to chaos and charm.
Increases all allies' final damage reduction by 30%.
Decreases all enemies' attack by 30%.
After being attacked, heals all allies with 30% rate, and has 30% chance to dispel 1 random enemy's buffs.
Attacks all enemies with 300% growth rate.
90% rate to inflict curse fixation and tsukuyomi for 2 rounds.
Ally vanguard and assaulters enter shatter storm state for 2 rounds.
Increases ally supporters' defenses by 100% for 2 rounds.
Dispels all allies' debuffs.
Decreases all enemies' attack by 30%, and enemy supporters enter weakened state for 2 rounds.
Restores 68 self fury, 30 for allies.

sourceNotes: Do not infer whether three numbered talent awakenings stack or are mutually exclusive.
Shatter Storm percentage not specified here: use the reusable default unless stronger source evidence gives an override.
The healing “30% rate” is not confidently an activation chance.
No source URL, rating, formation, release date, nature or base stats provided in this post.

The following apply:
1) Deva Path — Decreases all allies' (except self) reflect damage taken by 70% rate, OR Animal Path — Ally supporters have a 70% chance to enter super dodge.
2) Preta Path — Increases ally vanguard and assaulters' attack by 40% for 2 rounds, OR Ashura Path — Increases self defenses by 500% for 1 round.
3) Naraka Path — Dispels allies' (except self) debuffs, OR Human Path — Decreases enemies' healing by 60% rate.

sourceNotes: Three independent OR pairs appear WITHIN the skill; do not turn all six into one global talent-choice group.
No evidence of the selection method or whether options are triggered by nature; record the OR pairs without inventing a mechanic.
“s.attack rate (can exceed cap)” must retain cap exception.
Preserve original name capitalization, later resolve existing ninja ID by release list.
